summary: Applies the PNG row transform pipeline to one decoded image row of a PNG info context struct (a1). Guarding on two transform-flag bytes in the context, it sequentially invokes the decompression, palette, expansion, dithering, background, unpacking, swapping, and inversion subroutines, passing the row buffer, rowbytes (buffer pointer value + 1), and context parameters as arguments. Two fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp paths protect against a NULL row buffer at entry and zero rowbytes output after PixelFormatConverter. Returns void.

operations.description: Guard: row buffer pointer (this+0xDC) must be non-null. If null, fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp with string 'NULL row buffer' (global:0x005AF474). Single caller is sub_511B7C.
Guard: PNG transform flags upper byte (this+0x61) bit 0x10 set selects the deinterlace/expand branch.
Guard: PNG color type (this+0xF8) == 3 (indexed/palette) selects sub_512E1A path: call with buffer, rowbytes+1, this+0x104, this+0x15C, and this+0x10A.
Guard: when color type != 3 and the row width word (this+0x10A) is non-zero, call BitmapDecompression with a word-pointer third argument.
Else branch: call BitmapDecompression with null third argument (no word pointer) when the row width word is zero.

Guard: flags upper byte bit 0x20 set AND color type (this+0x116) != 3 selects palette transform: call sub_512ACC with buffer, rowbytes+1, source pointer this+0x138, and parameters this+0x144 and this+0x12C.
Guard: flags upper byte bit 0x04 set selects BitExpandDecompress on the row buffer.
Guard: PNG transform flags lower byte (this+0x60) bit 0x40 set selects PixelFormatConverter with parameters this+0x174 and this+0x178.
Guard: after PixelFormatConverter, rowbytes output (this+0xF4) must be non-zero. If zero, fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp with string 'png_do_dither returned rowbytes=0' (global:0x005AF450).
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x08 set selects sub_5126D9 background processing on the row buffer.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x04 set selects BitPackingUnpacking on the row buffer.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x01 set selects sub_5123E0 on the row buffer.
Guard: flags upper byte signed negative (bit 0x80 set, guard:0) selects PixelFormatExpansion with row buffer, rowbytes+1, bit depth this+0x11E, and width this+0x5C.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x10 set selects sub_5123B3 on the row buffer.
Function returns void; no value is produced.

unresolved: The unnamed callees sub_512E1A, sub_512ACC, sub_5126D9, sub_5123B3, sub_5123E0 implement individual PNG transform stages; their exact semantics are not independently confirmed.

Several call arguments (the buffer base pointer, the word pointer, and the byte pointer passed to the transform helpers) are derived from the context struct but have no packet field-table entry; their struct layout roles are unconfirmed.
The PNG info struct owner/type is UNKNOWN; field layout beyond the accessed offsets is unconfirmed.
The color-type checks (== 3 indexed/palette path, != 3 palette-transform gate) need a PNG spec cross-check to confirm exact palette semantics.
Rowbytes is computed as the value stored in the row-buffer pointer field (this+0xDC) plus 1; whether that field stores rowbytes or a buffer pointer used as both is unconfirmed.
